entities.name: Russification & the Jewish Pale of Settlement
entities.label: EventWindow
entities.summary: Tsarist Russification banned Belarusian-language printing and dissolved the Uniate Church (1839). The Pale of Settlement made Belarusian cities major centres of Jewish life, culture, and the emerging Zionist movement.
